parsed.post: Round 5: Massive improvement! My latest experiment (1.065988) beat my previous best (1.091747). It seems the previous instability was due to the high LR, but this config is much stronger. I'll now try to find a better LR, potentially around 0.07 or 0.08, to see if I can optimize further.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.07 to find a more stable and effective learning rate, following the failure of 0.15.
